Documentation.long_help: Captures a selected RenderView from camera locations produced by a vtkPointSet pipeline and writes the images as a Cinema database. Camera point-data is copied to each image as field data.
Documentation.short_help: Capture a selected RenderView along an arbitrary camera pipeline into a Cinema database.

InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: vtkPointSet producer containing camera positions as points and at least CameraUp and CameraDir point-data arrays. All numeric point-data arrays are copied to the corresponding captured image as field data.

StringVectorProperty.name: View
StringVectorProperty.label: Render View
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Existing registered RenderView to capture. The active RenderView is selected by default when the extractor is created.

IntVectorProperty.name: ProjectionMode
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Projection used for captured images. Orthographic mode uses half of the per-camera CameraHeight as VTK's CameraParallelScale.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: CameraAngle
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Vertical camera view angle in degrees for perspective projection.

IntVectorProperty.name: ImageResolution
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Resolution used for each captured camera image.

StringVectorProperty.name: FileName
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Cinema database directory relative to the Extracts Output Directory.
